snippet.title: OBSERVE (0BSERVE 観測) | Psychological Horror set in Japan | Steam Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam!
store.steampowered.com/app/4538590/OBSERVE/

Step into OBSERVE (0BSERVE 観測) — a first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese subway station.
Explore highly detailed liminal spaces and make your escape.

「本作は日本の駅を舞台にした、一人称視点の心理的ホラーゲームでございます。狭間の空間をご探索の上、出口をお探しください。」

「あなたは一体、何を通り抜けているのか。」
Just what are you passing through?
